text: 还有一个多月就40了
en: There's just over a month to go until I turn 40.

text: 自问这么多年一直很要强，自从老二出生后全职已经八年了，以前一直想着工作，所以一直没有放弃学习，学了似乎也没有用，除了提高点学历，一点用都没有，到现在孩子也出不了手，其实如果够狠心也能出手，比如扔到老家去，但是，又舍不得，本来计划考个教资，结果，出现双减政策，似乎学出来也没有用，想办法开班，遇见了疫情，积极性也没有了。
en: I ask myself, all these years I've always been very driven. Since the second child was born I've been a full-time mother for eight years. Before, I always wanted to work, so I never gave up studying, but what I studied seems to have been of no use — apart from raising my qualifications a little, it's been utterly useless. Even now I still can't hand the children off. Actually, if I were hard-hearted enough I could hand them over, for instance by sending them to the grandparents, but I can't bear to. I had planned to sit the teaching qualification exam, but then the double reduction policy came in, and it seems what I'd learn would be of no use either. I tried to find a way to run my own classes, but ran into the pandemic, and lost my motivation.

text: 身体越来越差了，从去年起开始有鼻炎了，估计免疫力太差了，一顿饭不吃头晕眼花，很多时候力不从心了，看看手上的事业型长长的一根都是骗人的，劳心费力是真的。
en: My health keeps getting worse. Since last year I've had rhinitis — probably my immunity is too weak. If I skip a single meal I feel dizzy and light-headed, and many times now my body can't keep up with my will. Look at that long career line on my hand — it's all a lie; the truth is nothing but worry and toil.

text: 想想年龄也不是很大，但是力不从心，每天懒懒的，就想躺着，记性也不好了，很多时候不服老也不成，可是现在真的还不老啊，不知道办了班，有没有精力管孩子。
en: Thinking about it, my age isn't all that old, yet my body can't keep up with my will. Every day I'm listless and just want to lie down; my memory is failing too. Many times I can't even refuse to admit I'm ageing, but I really am not old yet. I don't know whether, having run classes, I'd have the energy to look after the children.

text: 老公每天想着养老生活，想找个简单的工作，哪怕工资少些，可是无论你工资多少，老板都是不养闲人的啊，工资少不见得不累，他讨厌复杂的人际关系，也不想承担任何责任，不想做管理人员，就想做自己的技术，不想管项目，也不想管人，可是40了啊，这样的想法不知道能混多久。
en: My husband thinks about retirement every day; he wants to find a simple job, even if the pay is lower. But no matter what your salary, a boss doesn't keep idle hands on. Lower pay doesn't mean less tiring work. He hates complicated interpersonal relationships and doesn't want to take on any responsibility; he doesn't want to be in management, just wants to do his own technical work, doesn't want to manage projects or people. But he's 40 — I don't know how long this way of thinking can carry him.

text: 我经常给他打气，40岁退休太早了，退休了无所事事，人啊更容易出现问题，坚持50岁退休。
en: I often cheer him on: retiring at 40 is far too early. Once retired with nothing to do, a person is all the more prone to problems. Hold on to retiring at 50.

text: 不管怎么样，还得坚持十年，给自己加油吧！
en: No matter what, I still have to hold on for another ten years — give myself some encouragement!

text: 这么多年来一直省吃俭用，辛辛苦苦，我老公说退休后是你享福的时候，带你游遍大江南北！
en: All these years I've scrimped and saved and worked so hard. My husband says that after retirement is when you get to enjoy yourself — he'll take you travelling all across the country!

text: 有希望是好的！
en: Having hope is a good thing!

text: 40岁很多都看透了，不在那么热情了，只想安安静静的，也不在想不想爱不爱的问题了，一切随缘，善待身边每一位人。
en: At 40 you see through so much; you're no longer so enthusiastic, you just want quiet, and you stop dwelling on whether to love or not. Let everything follow its course, and be kind to everyone around you.

text: 希望我的父母公婆健健康康，儿女快快乐乐的学习，我们平平安安。
en: I hope my parents and my parents-in-law stay healthy, my children study happily, and we remain safe and sound.

text: 有时候难得糊涂，知足常乐。
en: Sometimes it's best to be blissfully muddled; contentment brings lasting joy.

text: 觉得挺好的呀
en: I think it's rather good.

text: 人生体会就是人这一辈子每天都是最年轻的一天
en: The lesson life has taught me is that every day of a person's life is the youngest day they will ever have.

text: 乐观点 年轻多存点钱早点自由。
en: Be a bit more optimistic; while you're young save up more money so you can gain your freedom sooner.

text: 不断的追求新爱好
en: Keep pursuing new hobbies.

text: 不断地调节情绪呗 还能干啥 呆着呗 想干点啥干点啥
en: Just keep regulating your mood — what else can you do? Sit around, do whatever happens to take your fancy.

text: 没事就溜达
en: When there's nothing on, just go for a stroll.

text: 身体还行，父母也健康，能吃能喝能睡，保持心情的愉快最重要，要珍惜每一天善待自己，因为以后的每一天只会越来越老。
en: My health is all right and my parents are healthy too; I can eat, drink and sleep. Keeping a cheerful mood is what matters most — treasure each day and be kind to yourself, because every day from now on will only be older.

text: 认识一个朋友，40岁，有一娃，离异。
en: I know a friend, 40 years old, with one child, divorced.

text: 认识她的时候，她应该还是30出一点点头，但看上去依然是少女感十足。
en: When I first met her she was probably only just past 30, yet she still looked every bit the young girl.

text: 直到现在，她在我眼中还是妥妥的白富美。
en: To this day, in my eyes she remains the very picture of a fair, rich and beautiful woman.

text: 爱唱歌，爱跳舞，有自己的茶艺事业，爱自拍，爱运动，爱旅游。
en: She loves singing and dancing, has her own tea-ceremony business, loves taking selfies, loves sport, loves travelling.

text: 状态好的不得了，完全活出了冻龄感。
en: Her condition is extraordinarily good; she has completely lived out an ageless quality.

text: 在我看来，心不老就永远年轻。
en: In my view, if the heart does not age, one stays young forever.

text: 不管男人女人，顶级的快乐是能驾驭自我意志，作为一个生命体享受生命流动的乐趣。
en: Whether man or woman, the supreme happiness is to master one's own will, and as a living being to enjoy the pleasure of life's flowing current.

text: 无为而无不为。
en: Do nothing, and there is nothing that is not done.

text: 被生活裹挟向前，蛮想摆烂，但是有责任有义务要去走
en: Swept along by life, I rather want to slack off and let things be, but there are responsibilities and duties I must carry on with.

text: 打起精神来，好好干吧
en: Pull yourself together and get on with the work.

text: 怕死，主要是肩膀上担着两头，一头是父母渐渐老去，已经进入了需要我们关心呵护的年纪，另一头是孩子尚小，还需要父母的强力支撑和培养教育，二十年以后估计我就可以淡然的面对死亡了，因为那个时候已经尽到了做子女和父母的义务，问心无愧，没有后患的可以走了。
en: I'm afraid of death, mainly because I carry two ends on my shoulders: one end is my parents gradually ageing, already at the age where they need our care and protection; the other end is the children, still small, still needing their parents' strong support and upbringing. Twenty years from now I expect I'll be able to face death calmly, because by then I'll have done my duty as both child and parent, with a clear conscience and no loose ends left to burden me.

text: 一是工作压力更大，不敢随便换工作，想换个工作吧，看招聘启事，年龄都超了，多是要35岁以下，40岁以上，就是清洁工，洗碗工的岗位。
en: First, work pressure is greater; I dare not change jobs at will. When I do think of changing and look at the job adverts, I'm already over the age limit — most want under 35, and for those over 40 the only posts are cleaner or dishwasher.

text: 二是感受到家庭的压力更大。
en: Second, I feel the pressure from the family is greater.

text: 上面老人已经将近七十等你养老，下面孩子也是准备拍拖结婚，上有老，下有小，都是指望四十岁的你来赚钱。
en: The elderly above are nearly seventy, waiting for you to support them in old age; the children below are also getting ready to date and marry. With the old above and the young below, both are counting on you at forty to earn the money.

text: 三是自身健康方面，明显感觉精力会跟不上，单位加班会觉得累，回家老婆也不能太理解你。
en: Third, in my own health I clearly feel my energy can no longer keep up. Working late at the unit leaves me exhausted, and at home my wife doesn't quite understand me either.

text: 焦虑情绪会上升。
en: Anxious feelings will rise.

text: 四十而不惑，古人说的轻巧。
en: 'At forty one is free of doubts' — the ancients said it lightly enough.

text: 现实里四十岁的男人，身体机能开始下坡，上有老人，下有小孩，身边的妻子时时埋怨，不惑又能怎样！
en: In reality a forty-year-old man finds his bodily functions already in decline, with elderly parents above and young children below, and a wife at his side who complains all the time — so what good is being free of doubts!

text: 四十岁以后，开始讨厌无效社交，开喜欢一个人独处，开始控制压抑自己的情绪渐渐的活成一个连自己都讨厌的人。
en: After forty, one begins to detest pointless socialising and starts to like being alone; one begins to control and suppress one's emotions, gradually becoming a person even one dislikes.

text: 四十岁以后，情绪变化特别快，刷个抖音会突然泪流满面，看一段话，听半首歌都可能感动…
en: After forty, moods shift especially fast — scrolling through Douyin you might suddenly be in tears; reading a passage or hearing half a song can move you…

text: 吃东西开始注重营养，晚上尽量早点睡觉，孩子们的无理取闹开始学会容忍
en: One starts to care about nutrition in food, tries to sleep earlier at night, and learns to tolerate the children's unreasonable tantrums.

text: 眼下感觉解决中年人的就业问题更为重要
en: At the moment I feel that solving middle-aged people's employment problem is the more pressing matter.

text: 中年人就业问题是很紧迫的，失业率太高整个社会就像四处埋了雷
en: The employment problem of middle-aged people is very urgent; with unemployment so high, the whole society is like mines buried everywhere.

text: 近日与许久不联系的大学同学微信聊天
en: Recently I had a WeChat chat with a university classmate I hadn't been in touch with for a long time.

text: 说他们行业是偏重硬件的，由于现行业不景气，结果最近一同事被HR劝退，年龄在42左右吧
en: He said their industry leans heavily towards hardware. Because the sector is currently in a downturn, a colleague was recently talked into leaving by HR, aged around 42.

text: 之前工资税后15000不到，部门经理天天劝他，他不走。
en: Before that his after-tax salary was under 15,000; the department manager urged him to go every day, but he wouldn't leave.

text: 一个人坐在饭堂里流泪我同学也感同身受仿佛就像是看到了今后的自己
en: Sitting alone in the canteen in tears, my classmate felt it keenly too, as if he were looking at his own future self.

text: 还有一次遇到一个快车司机，说自己才刚做不到一个月，本职工作与展会相关，这三年疫情期间业务都做不了，国外的合同也都撤销了，公司裁得就剩下几个骨干也没事情可干拿着基础工资，但是他2019年年底买了房月供1万多，老婆不上班在家带孩子，现只能出来开快车，想想确实生活不易…
en: Another time I met a ride-hailing driver who said he'd only been at it for less than a month. His actual job was tied to exhibitions; over these three pandemic years he couldn't do any business, and all the overseas contracts were cancelled. His company cut staff until only a few core people remained, with nothing to do but draw a base salary. But he'd bought a flat at the end of 2019 with a monthly mortgage of over 10,000, and his wife doesn't work and stays home with the child, so now he can only come out to drive ride-hailing. Thinking about it, life really isn't easy…

text: 本人自己也是上有老下有小，一家老小的支柱，随着父母年纪越来越大，需要你照顾的时间就会越来越多
en: I myself also have the old above and the young below, and am the pillar of the whole family. As my parents grow older, the time they need me to care for them will only grow.

text: 小孩越长越大，要你操心的事情也随之越来越多，中考，高考，找工作，找对象等等…
en: As the children grow, the things that weigh on you grow with them: the senior secondary entrance exam, the university entrance exam, finding a job, finding a partner, and so on…

text: 都需要付出很大的精力和财力
en: All of it demands a great deal of energy and money.

text: 但明显感觉人一过中年，自己的身体状况也在开始走下坡路
en: But I clearly feel that once one passes middle age, one's own physical condition also starts to go downhill.

text: 层面高一点就是欲望了，无欲则刚
en: At a deeper level it comes down to desire — be without desire and you stand firm.

text: 四十岁左右的中年人，身已衰心未老，有太多人生抱负没有实现，于是在理想和现实中不断纠结，有的人想开了，从此活得通透，有的人想不开，在遗憾中怨天尤人，感叹命运不公。
en: A middle-aged person around forty has a body already in decline yet a heart not yet old, with too many life ambitions left unfulfilled, and so keeps struggling between ideal and reality. Some come to see through it and from then live with real clarity; others never do, and in regret blame heaven and others, sighing at fate's unfairness.

text: 五十而知天命，其实再过十年的磨合期，多数人都会想开，回过头来再看四十岁的经历，一切释然。
en: At fifty one knows the mandate of Heaven. In truth, after another ten years of accommodation, most people will come to terms with it; looking back on the experience of being forty, everything is released.
